faq.question: Can Indian students study Chemical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply directly to English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: What is the duration of a Chemical Engineering degree in Finland?
What are the tuition fees for Chemical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees for international students range from €10,000 to €12,000 at the bachelor

faq.question: Is IELTS mandatory for Chemical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: While IELTS (minimum 6.0–6.5) is standard, universities also accept TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, SAT scores, or alternative university entrance assessments.
